A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sweet potato puree rheological parameters and chemical composition are important in predicting rehydrated sweet potato flakes texture and acceptability.
sweet potato cultivars differ in rheological, chemical and textural characteristics and that these properties are related.
there is a need for a more complete understanding of the rheological characteristics of sweet potato purees and the effect of dehydration on those characteristics.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the chemical and rheological characteristics of sweet potato puree and rehydrated sweet potato flakes are highly dependent on sweet potato cultivars and that the chemical and textural characteristics of rehydrated flakes can be predicted from the chemical and rheology of the puree.
the rheological, chemical, and textural properties of sweet potato puree are highly variable and that these properties can be used to predict the quality of sweet potato flakes.
the chemical, rheological, and textural properties of the rehydrated sweet potato flakes can be manipulated by the selection of the raw sweet potato cultivars and the processing methods used.
